Name: Finance Skill
Author: MarsXsyper
Description:
[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
Finance Skill adds a new custom skill to Stardew Valley focused on the financial side of farm life.
Earn Finance experience from eligible income, increase your items’ sell prices as you level up, and choose professions that introduce coupons, Prize Tickets, passive income, credit, cashback, and purchase discounts.
The skill features 10 levels, two level 5 professions, and four branching level 10 professions

[size=4][b]MAIN FEATURES[/b][/size]

• Increase item sell prices by 1% per Finance level, up to +10% at level 10.
• Discover four new books that grant Finance XP or permanent powers.
• Access a wallet directly from your inventory, available from day one.
• Keep coupons and Prize Tickets in your wallet without occupying inventory or chest slots.
• Apply coupons to supported shop, building, and animal purchases.
• Choose between wallet-first payments and full credit card payments.
• Manage available credit, outstanding debt, and manual repayments through your wallet.
• Use credit for regular shops, backpack upgrades, buildings, house and cabin upgrades, community upgrades, and animal purchases.
• Support for compatible modded purchases that use the supported vanilla systems.
• Purchased-item tracking prevents Finance XP exploits from reselling purchased items.
• Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support.
• Controller support for the wallet, coupon selector, payment buttons, and enhanced Prize Machine interface.
• Seven supported languages.
• Purchase prices reflect credit surcharges or Loyalty Program discounts, with red pricing when credit is used.
• Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support for HUD visibility, mouse dragging, fixed X/Y positioning, purchased-item counters and profession values.


FINANCE PROGRESSION
Eligible income grants Finance experience equal to 1% of the amount received. Fractional experience carries over toward future gains.
Purchased items do not grant Finance XP when resold, shipped, or recycled through the trash can. Passive Income and Cashbacker payouts also do not grant Finance XP.
Purchased quantities are tracked within mixed stacks. Legitimate units are consumed first, allowing their income to grant XP normally. Items transformed into a different product can grant XP normally.
Every Finance level increases item sell prices by 1%, reaching +10% at level 10. Reading It’s Raining Money! permanently adds another 5 percentage points, bringing the level 10 bonus to +15%. Skill descriptions display your current total bonus.

THE WALLET
Open your inventory and select the wallet button below Organize.
The first page displays your money and stored coupons and Prize Tickets. Items appear as icons, with names and details shown when hovered over or focused with a controller.
The Credit page becomes available with the Credit Card profession. It displays your available credit, outstanding debt, card status, and manual payment options.
Coupons and Prize Tickets remain usable items, but are stored separately from normal inventory slots. Existing copies in your inventory are moved into the wallet, as are copies found in chests when you open them.

COUPONS
Supported shops, construction menus, and animal purchases include a coupon selector alongside the payment options.
The selector shows compatible coupons available in your wallet. Only one coupon can be used per purchase.
After a successful purchase, the same coupon remains selected while more copies remain in your wallet. The selection clears when that type runs out. You can also change coupons or choose not to use one.
Selecting a coupon does not consume it. Failed or cancelled purchases do not consume it either.

Shopping Coupon
• 5% off supported gold-based shop purchases.
• No maximum savings.
• With Coupon Master: 10% off.
Building Coupon
• 10% off supported building purchases.
• Maximum savings: 2,000g.
• With Coupon Master: 20% off, up to 4,000g.
Animal Coupon
• 10% off supported animal purchases.
• Maximum savings: 1,000g.
• With Coupon Master: 20% off, up to 2,000g.
Joja Coupon
• 20% off purchases at JojaMart.
• No maximum savings.
• With Coupon Master: 40% off.
• Requires Joja membership obtained before completing the Community Center.
• Eligible new members receive a thank-you letter from Morris containing one Joja Coupon the following day.
Coupons can also appear in Mystery Boxes:
• Regular Mystery Boxes: 1% chance per eligible coupon type.
• Golden Mystery Boxes: 3% chance per eligible coupon type.
Joja Coupons follow the membership restriction regardless of how they are obtained.
Coupon discounts are applied before credit surcharges or Loyalty Program discounts. Building materials, animal housing, stock, and other purchase requirements remain necessary.
Coupon selection is available in supported shops, construction menus, and animal purchases. Separate backpack and upgrade dialogues provide payment choices but do not include coupon selection.

FINANCE BOOKS
How to Make Your First Million
• Grants 250 Finance XP each time it is read.
• Available from the Bookseller for 2,500g.
• Has a 2% chance to appear in Golden Mystery Boxes.
It’s Raining Money!
• Permanently adds 5 percentage points to the Finance sell-price bonus.
• First reading unlocks the power; subsequent readings grant 250 Finance XP.
• Available from the Bookseller for 35,000g.
• Has a 2% chance to appear in Golden Mystery Boxes.
The Legend of the Golden Boot
• Permanently grants 1g for each step taken.
• First reading unlocks the power; subsequent readings grant 250 Finance XP.
• Has a 1% chance to drop when breaking gold nodes with a pickaxe or bombs.
• Also available from the Bookseller for 50,000g starting in year 3.
How to Win the Lottery
• Unlocks an enhanced Prize Machine interface in Mayor Lewis’ house.
• One Prize Ticket grants three consecutive rewards from the normal reward progression.
• First reading unlocks the power; subsequent readings grant 100 Finance XP.
• Has a 1% chance to appear in regular Mystery Boxes.
• Works independently of Coupon Master.
Price Catalogue now gives Finance XP
• Keeps its original effect.
• Subsequent readings now also grant 250 Finance XP.
Permanent book powers do not stack through repeated readings.

PROFESSION TREE
Level 5: Couponist
→ Level 10: Passive Income or Coupon Master
Level 5: Credit Card
→ Level 10: Cashbacker or Loyalty Program

COUPONIST
Level 5 Profession
Each morning, receive independent chances for rewards by mail:
• 3% chance for a Prize Ticket.
• 5% chance for a Shopping Coupon.
• 5% chance for a Building Coupon.
• 5% chance for an Animal Coupon.
• 4% chance for a Joja Coupon, if eligible.
More than one reward letter can arrive on the same day.
Choosing Couponist unlocks Passive Income and Coupon Master at level 10.

PASSIVE INCOME
Level 10 — Requires Couponist
Receive 10% of your current wallet balance every morning.
This payout does not grant Finance XP or count toward the monthly income used to calculate your credit limit.

COUPON MASTER
Level 10 — Requires Couponist
Double the discounts and maximum savings of all coupons.
Each coupon successfully used also has a 1% chance to grant a Prize Ticket, stored directly in your wallet.
Coupon descriptions display the improved values while this profession is active.
The former three-reward Prize Machine effect is now unlocked through the "How to Win the Lottery" book. Players upgrading from an earlier version with Coupon Master already acquired automatically retain that effect as the book’s power.


CREDIT CARD
Level 5 Profession
Make supported purchases using credit when your wallet cannot cover the cost, or choose to finance the entire purchase.
Your total credit limit equals 20% of your highest recorded income during a completed month. Available credit is your total limit minus your outstanding debt.
For example, a highest recorded monthly income of 100,000g establishes a total credit limit of 20,000g.
Your highest recorded monthly income never decreases.

PAYMENT OPTIONS
• Coin mode uses your wallet first and automatically finances any remaining cost with credit.
• Card mode charges the entire purchase to credit, preserving your wallet balance.
• Coin mode is selected automatically whenever you open a supported shop or construction menu.
• Backpack and supported upgrade dialogues offer separate wallet-first and full-credit purchase choices.
By default, the credit-funded portion receives a 10% surcharge. Available credit must cover the resulting charge.
Materials and other purchase requirements remain necessary. Credit covers the money cost only.

DEBT AND INTEREST
Debt is paid manually through the wallet’s Credit page. You can make partial payments or pay as much as your available money allows.
Incoming earnings remain in your wallet and no longer automatically repay debt.
At the start of each new season, outstanding debt receives 15% interest. This includes any unpaid interest from previous seasons.
When interest is applied, the card becomes locked. Additional credit is unavailable until the entire debt has been repaid. The card unlocks automatically when the debt reaches zero.

CASHBACKER
Level 10 — Requires Credit Card
Receive cashback the following morning based on the previous day’s credit-funded purchases.
Cashback equals 25% of the financed principal, excluding the credit surcharge. Amounts paid directly from your wallet do not count.
Cashback does not grant Finance XP or count toward the monthly income used to calculate your credit limit.

LOYALTY PROGRAM
Level 10 — Requires Credit Card
Remove the normal 10% credit surcharge and receive a 5% discount on the credit-funded portion of purchases.
Amounts paid directly from your wallet retain their normal price.

PURCHASE COMPATIBILITY
Credit is supported for:
• Regular shop purchases.
• Backpack upgrades.
• Robin and Wizard buildings.
• House and cabin upgrades.
• Community upgrades.
• Marnie’s animal purchases.
Compatible modded shops, buildings, and animals can use the same support when they follow the supported vanilla purchase systems. Custom purchase systems implemented by other mods may require additional compatibility, in which case I may be willing to make it.
Displayed prices account for applicable discounts and surcharges. Red pricing indicates that the purchase uses credit.

HUD AND CONFIGURATION
The credit HUD displays available credit and outstanding debt. Its default position is below the quest button beneath the money display.
With Generic Mod Config Menu, you can:
• Show purchased-unit counters in item stacks.
• Open the dedicated Professions page to adjust profession effects.
The Professions page includes:
• Couponist: separate mail chances for Normal Coupons, Joja Coupons, and Prize Tickets. Normal Coupons share one setting for Shopping, Building, and Animal Coupons.
• Passive Income: daily income percentage.
• Coupon Master: multiplier for both coupon discounts and maximum savings.
• Credit Card: purchase surcharge and seasonal debt interest.
• Cashbacker: cashback percentage.
• Loyalty Program: discount on the credit-funded portion of purchases.
Profession and coupon descriptions automatically reflect your configured values. The original balance values remain the defaults.
The Credit Card section also lets you:
• Show or hide the credit HUD.
• Enable or disable HUD dragging.
• Set the HUD’s X/Y coordinates.
When dragging is enabled, hold either mouse button over the HUD to move it. The chosen position is saved automatically.
Payment buttons are always enabled.
The optional purchased-item display shows a red counter on stacks containing purchased units and adds the exact purchased quantity to the item description.
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. Settings can also be edited through config.json.


LANGUAGES
• English
• Brazilian Portuguese
• Spanish
• Russian
• French
• Italian
• German
Translations follow the game’s selected language, with English as the fallback.

[size=4][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]
-Giving more freedom and ways to use the Credit Card, Coupon and Wallet systems.
-And more? All and any suggestions are welcome.


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

Stardew Valley 1.6
SMAPI
SpaceCore


[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install SpaceCore.
3. Download Finance Skill.
4. Extract the "Finance Skill" folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
5. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
